page.overview:
What is Steering committee?

The Steering Committee was an advisory body of Damask Holdings, formed by select politicians, financiers representing several organizations and worlds, such as Sestina, and the Bank of the Core, the elite of the Order of the Canted Circle and the Trade Federation Directorate, as well as Narro Sienar and other ship designers. The committee met periodically on the moon of Sojourn, to assure the swift passage of corporate-friendly legislation, fix the price of commodities such as Tibanna gas, transparisteel and several other materials. While, keeping senators in the Galactic Republic's capital of Coruscant. In 52 BBY, killed at an attack on the Lodge of the Order of the Canted Circle by Maladian assassins.

The steering committee appeared in the 2012 novel Darth Plagueis, written by James Luceno.
